notes.title: 🏮The one-day romance drama "One Day of Romance" is now officially live on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/0c7e5edc4df9d6bb036a692287f7d17b1d4ed9f9.png[/img]
[h4]👇️ [Head to the Rendezvous Immediately, Unveil the Millennia-Old Romance Scheme] [/h4]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690230/_/
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🍧Game Introduction：[/h2]
[quote=author] 🏮Chang'an Moon Rises, Painted Boats Sway with Candles
——As a mysterious passerby in the brothel, use wisdom and strategy to uncover the dusty past beneath the prosperous facade💌.....In the ancient charm world of poetry, wine, and romance🍶, experience segments of entangled and poignant destined encounters💫 [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/744d994759a2aaaf8a0f707f5d29888b31091ff9.png[/img]
[quote=author] Encounter five stunning beauties: The strategizing manager🌺, the charming and seductive noble sister💋, the gentle and proper lady🎐, the karma-entangled cat spirit🐾, the enigmatic girl with shattered memories and red pupils❄️ [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/04124281f26bd8986e466bd73882340d6c512a1b.png[/img]
[h3]🌙"Grand Tang Romance × Intellectual Game × Hidden Emotions Card-Flipping Secret Game"[/h3]
[quote=author] 🏮 Grand Tang Card-Flipping Secret Game: In the meticulously drawn national style card array, match suits/numbers, solve puzzles with intellect! Each level victory unlocks stunning standing illustrations, delving into the beauties' most hidden emotional worlds.
[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/32bfc7ebfba8e76c15012cbc621ba7cb11bba280.png[/img]
[quote=author] 🃏 Use "Elegant Intellectual Strategy" to crack the golden thread card bureaus, unlock 22 scenes of Grand Tang court secret scrolls from subtle tenderness🌸 to deep emotional revelation🌊!  [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/b95299fd10f7bbda5baf9ef47e3d924e298072dd.png[/img]
[quote=author] • Top-right corner provides “Reset Level🔁” and “Skip▶️” functions, after clearing don't forget to enter the album to relive touching moments～🎞️ [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/ab61bd71458191b47df2ddbc7ffe72a96cc8116f.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]💮 Game Features 💮 [/h3]
[list]
    [*]🏮 Easy Card-Flipping Gameplay: Click to match identical suits or numbers to eliminate cards, level victory directly unlocks stunning national style standing illustrations.
    [*]🎭 Five Great Beauties' Deep Charms:  Brothel Manager·Strategizing Behind the Scenes, Noble Twin Sisters·Mirror Flowers Water Moon, Night Cat Spirit Charm·Millennia Karma, White Hair Red Pupils·Shattered Memories Birth Emotions...Each past story is captivating.
    [*]🖌️ Exquisite National Style Graphics: Lavish costumes, retro scenes, a visual feast full of ancient charm, immersing you in the Grand Tang night banquet experience.
    [*]👘  Five Stunning Beauties: 22 characteristic standing illustrations customize your exclusive elegance! One-click skip for instant unlock~
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🌸 【 Five Great Beauties·Hundred States of Fragrance】[/h3]
[h3]🪭Talented Brothel Manager——Wan Qing[/h3][quote=author] Resolves countless storms with talk and laughter. Only to you does she devote her heart, hiding unknown tenderness.
“Don’t just stand there, let me teach you some fun things～” [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/5ec33651469190bbc3dcd9a619c53c3aa1f1bf70.png[/img]
[h3]❄️Frivolous and Charming Noble Miss——Ying Xue[/h3]
[quote=author] Every word and action carries seductive charm, revealing full elegance in the flow of glances.
“Sister went out today, so it’s just us here today……” [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/54138411496876331c25d03b969eddbc8149c35f.png[/img]
[h3]🎐Gentle and Learned Boudoir Jade——Ying Hua[/h3]
[quote=author] Proper and elegant in every gesture, only upon knowing you do ripples appear in her eyes.
“Let me see too, how you make sister happy?” [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/3096a437922a862330806516f6742b1be4ac94ed.png[/img]
[h3]🌙Mysterious White-Haired Girl——Golan[/h3]
[quote=author] Crimson eyes hide shattered pasts. In careful care, affections quietly grow……
“Will this really make you feel comfortable?” [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/7206e509ae41a2a7fb0238803dbef8a3306aaf55.png[/img]
[h3]🐾 Night Shadow Exquisite·Cat Spirit——Tian Jiao[/h3]
[quote=author] Lively silhouette encountered under the moon, enemy or friend? Beneath the quirky exterior surges millennia-old karma.
“Such a precious gift～I’ll accept it❤Hehe～” [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/45c79d56acc4b6e85f2f0c966d2a056363bd0fb8.jpg[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🎴"This affection can await becoming a memory, but at the time it was already lost……"——Can this scroll of gilded dream drawings not betray longing?
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45625951/90c00db63bb4bb3723647ac05a96a2b78796521a.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Thank you all for your support, kitty will continue to broadcast game news for you⌯>ᴗo⌯ಣ

notes.title: Game of Thrones, the struggle of desire - "Fairy Biography 6: Revenge" will be launched on Steam on August 9, 2024!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/37430609/ee985fa4d8bd1c96ae909a2f0ec4bf7a3a5326dd.png[/img]

[b]Fairy Biography 6: Revenge will be launched on Steam on August 9, 2024. [/b]

This game tells a fantasy story through a relaxing and puzzle-solving find-the-difference game - about the struggle for power between different races on this continent, the baptism of blood and the abyss of desire.

More new characters appear, bringing you a brand new experience!

If you are interested, you may click on the store page below to quickly purchase and play!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2937990/Fairy_Biography_6__Revenge/

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/f73ffab99bb5259cb6ac2a93d13862b4f7f476c5.png[/img]

This story takes place on a fantasy continent, where various races live.

Humans, werewolves, vampires, succubi... They are unwilling to live in peace in a corner, so the war started, the smoke filled the air, and the flames of the power struggle burned on the earth.

In the end, the vampire king won, but he was on the throne, but he was a playboy and a reveler.

The seeds of crisis quietly sprouted, and this continent is about to usher in an unprecedented disaster.
But perhaps, this will be an opportunity to reshuffle the races; perhaps, the continent will enter a new era.

And what did the people on this continent do and what price did they pay for this struggle for power and honor?

The ending is uncertain, everything is uncertain.
All of this will be witnessed by you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/7a9931643e4c0c618eead4a1df187a2e25549ce6.png[/img]

This is a puzzle game to find the difference.
In the game, you need to find all the differences between two pictures related to the story content by comparing them.
Each level has 3 differences. When all the differences in the successful circle are unlocked, the next level will be unlocked. After unlocking all levels, you can get the entire beautiful CG and gradually explore the true story of the whole game.

Which race will win the final victory, and what kind of adventures do they have in the story?
This is an ultimate test of the player's observation and concentration. Try to pass all levels to experience the complete story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/8228bed586e320117efebce6178705c6398d3a4e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Original world view and story of the imaginary continent
[*] Distinctive and different characters of different races
[*] A large number of rich and exquisite CGs
[*] Interesting and casual games, simple to play, pleasant to the body and mind
[*] One-click skip
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/39090a161b2286d1147eeff6a24ac280213b57fb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/0c7bafedf393ce932bb5e9c1913a05cb4c7cbe53.jpg[/img]
The one talking to the human leader Alinda is...
The elegant and sinister diplomat from the neighboring country?

She seems to have an unclear relationship with Alinda - after all, Alinda can give everything for the interests of the human camp.

[hr][/hr]

We are a group of developers who love games and life, and we are committed to creating a game that can touch people's hearts.

Customer service: LG Meow Friend code: 1478325586;

Steam group: https://steamcommunity.com/chat/invite/kPDvtqCg

Developer homepage: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/37430609

Customer service email: lovelygames888@gmail.com

[hr][/hr]

Of course, in addition to Fairy Biography 6: Revenge, we also have many games looking forward to meeting you!

[h2]A fascinating story: Ice Cream[/h2]

A derivative of A Fascinating Story. Are you curious about the past of Zhang Wei and Zhen Tian? How did the sweet and quiet junior in the company establish a secret relationship with Zhang Wei? At that time, Zhen Tian didn't seem to be as handy as she is now...

The game will be launched on September 6, 2024. All the answers are in A fascinating story: Ice Cream.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3088520/_/

[h2]Hot And Lovely XXII[/h2]

Hot And Lovely is back with a sequel. Classic match-3-match gameplay, keep clearing levels, and have a sweet date with the girls from the magic book!
The game is expected to be launched on October 1, 2024.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3088550/Hot_And_Lovely_XXII/

[h2]Hypnosis Cards 2[/h2]

Use hypnosis cards to fight against girls and interact with them in a heart-pounding way. It's up to you to decide whether you want to be a card master or a love expert!
The launch time of the game is yet to be determined, so stay tuned.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2863310/2/

notes.title: Delve into the secrets of the well-behaved female neighbor——"Joy Life 4" will be launched on Steam on time on July 26, 2024!
notes.content:
[b]Joy Life 4, the sequel to the Joy Life series, will be launched on Steam on July 26, 2024. [/b]This time, Lovely Games has brought you a brand new heroine. If you are interested, you may click on the store page below to quickly purchase and play!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3028000/Joy_Life_4/

[h2]Game Introduction[/h2]

A new neighbor has moved in next door to you. She has creamy skin, always has a sweet and energetic smile, soft hair hanging down the side of her neck, and a graceful figure below...
Her name is Heiman, and this name always comes to your mind and fascinates you.
In this seemingly ordinary world, your life has become extraordinary because of this imaginary girlfriend.
Heiman's arrival not only brings a lot of romance and surprises to your life, but also brings a series of challenges and adventures. You are more and more immersed in getting along with her. But you gradually realize that she doesn't seem to be as well-behaved and lovely as you imagined.

What secrets does Heyman have...?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051343/8e4419f28f82745d2ca4064534338f8b41e229c6.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

Inheriting the gameplay of previous Joy Life games, Joy Life 4 also brings you a card flipping game that tests your memory. In the game, you need to click on the cards to flip them and find two cards with the same picture. If the pictures are the same, it is a success and the two cards will be eliminated; if the cards turned out are inconsistent, the game will not change. When all the cards on the picture are eliminated, you can enter the next level. As the game progresses, you will unlock sweet interactions with your fantasy girlfriend, explore her secrets, and go on a wonderful date with her...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051343/7698dd7692ed45a7ebd2c045c4e6f9d02d83fb70.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

We are a group of developers who love games and life, and we are committed to creating a game that can touch people's hearts.

Steam group: https://steamcommunity.com/chat/invite/kPDvtqCg

Developer homepage: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/37430609

Customer service email: lovelygames888@gmail.com

[hr][/hr]

In addition to Joy Life 4, there are various games with different gameplays coming online soon.

[h2]Fairy Biography 6: Revenge[/h2]

Vampire? Succubus? All kinds of outsiders?
Perhaps, behind the grand epic, the desires, calculations and transactions on the dark side will impress you more.
The game will be launched on August 9, 2024, with new characters and new character lines waiting for you to explore.
